title: Excellent tour
text: We really enjoyed this tour. It was full of surprises and so much fun to discover the city at our own pace. My kids are 15, 12 and 8, and the challenges and quizzes were perfect for them. It was a really enjoyable experience.
author: Cami_M

title: Fantastic Family Experience
text: Took the kids on this tour and had a great time.  So much fun to explore at our own pace and the kids loved the challenges and quizzes.  What a brilliant way to see a city.  Definitely the highlight of our weekend in Barcelona!  The whole family loved it.
author: Sophie_C
